s: Diyyuqim benussach birkat hammazon, ubo t' seipim: seder birkat hammazon: rishona birkat "hazzan", sheniyya birkat haaretz, shelishit "boneh yerushalayim". Usheloshtan min hattora, shenneemar "veakalta vesabota uberakta" — zo birkat "hazzan", shehi al akila usebia, "al haaretz" — zo birkat haaretz, "hattoba" — zo yerushalayim, kemo shekkatub "hahar hattob hazzeh vehallebanon":

Min hattora yakol leomrah beezeh matbea sheyyirtzeh kol echad kepi dato veharchabat leshono, ubau mosheh vihoshua vedavid ushelomoh vetiqqenu hammatbea lekol beraka uberaka bizmannam lepi mah shennitvassep toba leyisrael:

Ketzad? Mosheh tiqqen matbea birkat "hazzan" beshaa sheyyarad hamman leyisrael. Yehoshua tiqqen matbea birkat haaretz kevan shenniknesu laaretz, sheqqodem kibbush haaretz hayu omerim bematbea acheret. Vedavid ushelomoh tiqnu matbea birkat "boneh yerushalayim". David tiqqen "al yisrael ammeka veal yerushalayim ireka" (sheqqodem laken hayu mebaqqeshim setam al ha"maqom asher yibchar Hashem leshakken shemo sham"), ushelomoh tiqqen "al habbayit haggadol vehaqqadosh shenniqra shimka alayv". Veanu en anu omerim birkat haaretz u"boneh yerushalayim" beoto hammatbea mammash, ki hem hayu mebaqqeshim lehamshik shalvat haaretz vehammalkut vehabbayit, veanu mebaqqeshim lehachaziram lanu beqarob:

Kol hamshanneh mimmatbea shettabeu (chakamim) — lo yatza yede chobato, umachazirin oto. Veiqqar hammatbea hamakkeb bebirkat "hazzan", hi petichat habberaka vachatimatah lebad. Ubebirkat haaretz tzarik lomar bah hodaa techilla vasop, uberit vetora baemtza, sheal yede berit nittena haaretz leabraham beparashat mila: "venatatti leka ulezaraka achareka et eretz megureka vego'", ubizkut hattora vehammitzvot yareshu et haaretz, shenneemar "lemaan tichyun urebitem ubatem virishtem et haaretz vego'", veomer: "vayyitten lahem artzot goyim vego' baabur yishmeru chuqqayv vetorotayv vego'". Vehappochet — lo yipchot mehodaa achat. Vekol happochet mehodaa achat — hare zeh megunneh. Vetzarik lehazkir shibchah shel eretz yisrael, shehi "eretz chemda toba urechaba", mippene shemmatzinu shennishtabbecha bazeh hallashon, shenneemar "el eretz toba urechaba vego'", veomer: "veetten lak eretz chemda vego'". Ub"boneh yerushalayim" tzarik lehazkir malkut bet david, mippene sheal yede david nitqaddesha yerushalayim. Veim chissar echad mikkol elleh, shello amar "eretz chemda toba urechaba", o shello hizkir berit o tora bebirkat haaretz, o malkut bet david be"boneh yerushalayim" — lo yatza yede chobato, umachazirim oto lerosh birkat hammazon, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qp"ch (hoil veshinna hammatbea shettabeu hannebiim. Abal hodaa techilla vasop enah meakkebet, kevan shechatam "baruk atta Hashem, al haaretz veku'"). Ubebirkat hazzan, apillu amar: "berik rachamana malka mareh dehay pitta, berik rachamana dezan kullah" — yatza, shekkevan sheppatach vechatam be"baruk" ap al pi sheddilleg kol hashshear — en zeh meshanneh mimmatbea shettabeu chakamim, lebad mehattebot shehizkiru chakamim sheyyesh bahem haqpada, kegon ellu shennitbaaru, ukemo shennitbaer besiman s"v vs"ch. Umikkol maqom, lekattechilla tzarik lomar kol hammatbea ketiqqunah, im lo liqtannim pechutim mishshemoneh shanim, shemmechannekin otam bebirkat hammazon meat meat (mikkol beraka, ad sheyyedeu lebarek kol beraka ketiqqunah). Veken bishat haddechaq, shehu nechpaz velo yukal lebarek bekavvana im yitztarek lebarek kol beraka arukka ketiqqunah — yakol leqatztzer uledalleg bebirkat haaretz ub"boneh yerushalayim" mah sheenan meinyene habberaka. Veen tzarik lomar bibraka rebiit, shehahosapa shebbah eno ella minhag lebad velo mittopes habberaka. Abal bebirkat "hazzan" en ledalleg bah (hoil vekullah meen habberaka):

Yesh nohagim lomar: "baruk masbia lareebim, baruk atta Hashem eloqenu melek haolam hazzan ku'". Veen leomro, sheeno mimmatbea habberaka, vehammosip — gorea. Velo yomar: "ki leolam chasdo immanu", ki chasadayv hem im kol chay:

Bebirkat haaretz lo yomar: "al shehinchalta laabotenu eretz chemda toba urechaba berit vetora", shehare omer: "al beriteka shechatamta bibsarenu veal torateka shellimmadtanu", veday bepaam echat. Umah sheameru shetztzarik lehazkir "berit vetora" — lo hattebot mammash, ella hainyan:

Yesh omerim shehannashim en lahem lomar: "al beriteka shechatamta bibsarenu", venashim vaabadim en lahem lomar: "veal torateka shellimmadtanu", shehare en metzuvvim al talmud tora. Veakshav nahagu lomar hakkol, lepi shekkevan sheen niqra "adam" ella kesheyyesh lo ishsha, kemo shenneemar "zakar uneqeba beraam, vayyiqra et shemam adam", hare hazzakar uneqeba hem gup echad, lepikak yekolot lomar al berit hazzekarim: "shechatamta bibsarenu", veken "torateka shellimmadtanu" al limmud hazzekarim. Veod, sheggam hannashim tzerikot lilmod mitzvot shellahen, leda haek laasotan, vehaek lizzaher mikkol lo taaseh shebbattora shehen muzharot bahen kaanashim, kemo shennitbaer besiman m"z:

Bachanukka upurim omerim bebirkat haaretz: "al hannissim". Veim lo amaro — en machazirin oto, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman trp"g vtrtz"h. Umikkol maqom, yakol lomar betok "harachaman", sheyyomar: "harachaman hu yaaseh lanu nissim veniplaot kemo sheasa laabotenu bayyamim hahem bizman veku'". Veken yesh linhog:
Yesh nohagim lomar: "lo chissar lanu, veal yechasser lanu". Veyesh nohagim lomar: "lo chasar, veal yechsar". "Bepi kol chay", velo "bepeh", lepi shehu samuk le"kol chay":
